subject.title: fix(control-ui): resolve Personal card avatar 401 via data URI

question: Should maintainers consolidate this avatar-401 fix onto https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97634 or ask this contributor to rebase and repair this narrower branch against the current Control UI layout?
rationale: Automation can identify the local type and stale-file blockers, but choosing the canonical PR for the overlapping open fix cluster requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Use the repaired broader PR
options.body: Prefer the proof-positive broader PR after its remaining SDK/compatibility blocker is repaired, then close or supersede this conflicting branch.

options.title: Keep this narrow branch alive
options.body: Ask the contributor to rebase onto current main, move the UI part into the current Quick Settings path, fix the type/lint blockers, and add real behavior proof.

options.title: Pause both until owner review
options.body: Leave both avatar PRs open until an owner chooses the resolver boundary and compatibility behavior.

recommendation.title: Use the repaired broader PR
recommendation.body: Prefer the proof-positive broader PR after its remaining SDK/compatibility blocker is repaired, then close or supersede this conflicting branch.
